Both require at least **three aliases, each appearing in at least two files**. Here, Archive appears in Seat/Team, Delete in Team/User, and Remove in Seat/User. All qualifying evidence is JSX copy, so both detectors produce identical evidence: **one underlying issue reported through two scopes**.
